description: The Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) flight model FM2 on GOES-17, a 16-channel visible/near-infrared/infrared imager of the GOES-R series. The curves are the GOES-R Calibration Working Group's processed channel relative spectral response functions (0.47-13.3 um), used for imagery, radiance and product calculations. Bands with the _81K suffix are the CWG's separate FM2 IR-channel SRFs for an 81 K focal-plane temperature.
facility_description: GOES-R is the NOAA/NASA series of geostationary weather satellites (GOES-16 to GOES-19) whose primary imager is the ABI.

notes: Flight-model mapping from the NCC page: 'PFM (aka FM1) on GOES-16, FM2 on GOES-17, FM3 on GOES-18, and FM4' (quoted from https://ncc.nesdis.noaa.gov/GOESR/ABI.php); the NCC page does not name FM4's satellite; GOES-19 = FM4 follows SVO's GOES/ABI4 record description 'GOES19 FM4 ABI ... normalized SRF' (archived SVO VOTable). The release note (2016-03-10) says the vendor SRFs were truncated by the CWG 'to the innermost 0.1% of the relative spectral response' and gives columns wavelength [um], wavenumber [cm-1], 'Relative spectral response'. Photon/energy weighting is not stated by the owner; the staged DetectorType=energy is tagged 'assumed' (SVO also uses energy counter for these IDs). DetectorTypeSource changed from assumed to original (2026-10-26, header only, curves unchanged): the GOES-R Calibration Working Group (Efremova, Pearlman, Padula & Wu 2016, Proc. SPIE 9972, 99720S, doi:10.1117/12.2238090; NOAA repository https://repository.library.noaa.gov/view/noaa/62008) writes that the detector output 'is proportional to the source spectral radiance L(λ) weighted by the detector specific spectral response' (Eq. 1, dn = C∫L(λ)SRF(λ)dλ) and computes the band-average calibration-source radiance as ∫L(λ)SRF_AV(λ)dλ / ∫SRF_AV(λ)dλ (Eq. 2), where 'a band-average SRF (SRF_AV) is used operationally to represent the spectral channel'. The SRF thus integrates directly over spectral radiance: energy in SED_Tools' convention.
